description: ENCODEURL -- RFC 3986 percent-encoding with uppercase hex (Excel 365 Mac ja-JP)

cases.skipped: Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL: the name resolves to #NAME? and Excel's own ERROR.TYPE(ENCODEURL(...)) returns 5, so the primary target produces no value to compare against. Scoped to the Mac target; a Windows host has the function and can capture these cases. Historical Windows files remain reference-only until a product-verified Microsoft 365 capture exists.
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?; ERROR.TYPE = 5). Formulon: "a/b c?d=1&e=2" -> "a%2Fb%20c%3Fd%3D1%26e%3D2".

Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?; ERROR.TYPE = 5). Formulon: unreserved characters pass through and `~` encodes as %7E (Excel's documented tilde behavior; pinned by tests/unit/eval/builtins_web_test.cpp, not by win-365-ja_JP which is reference-only).
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?; ERROR.TYPE = 5). Formulon: "日本語" -> "%E6%97%A5%E6%9C%AC%E8%AA%9E" (UTF-8 byte expansion, uppercase hex).
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?; ERROR.TYPE = 5). Formulon coerces TRUE -> "TRUE" then percent-encodes -> "TRUE" (all unreserved).
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?; ERROR.TYPE = 5). Formulon: "" -> "" (empty input passes through).
Mac Excel 365 ja-JP does not register ENCODEURL (#NAME?; ERROR.TYPE = 5). Formulon: "100%" -> "100%25" (percent itself is reserved).
